blocks.text: AI Mode 不只拖垮了谷歌的股价，也拖累了 Reddit。尽管业绩强劲，Reddit 股价仍下跌超过 25%，原因是CEO Steve Huffman 透露，10 月份 Reddit 每周从谷歌搜索损失的引荐流量超过一百万次。他将矛头指向 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode：“AI Mode 不带来流量。对我们如此，据我所知对任何人都是如此。这只是谷歌运作方式的一次根本性转变，”Huffman 说。

blocks.text: Reddit 表示平台的需求并未改变，只是谷歌不再把用户送过来了。作为应对，它正在美国以外地区测试登录墙，以遏制抓取行为、降低对开放网络的依赖。Huffman 认为这是一种取舍：牺牲覆盖面，换取更深的参与度。与 AI 提供商的数据授权谈判仍在继续，但 Reddit 此前已与谷歌达成协议并从中大赚一笔，能否再敲定更多交易尚不确定。

blocks.text: AI Mode has tanked not just Google's stock but Reddit's too. Shares dropped over 25 percent despite strong earnings, after CEO Steve Huffman revealed that Reddit lost more than one million Google search referrals per week in October. He blames AI Overviews and AI Mode: "AI Mode does not drive traffic. Not for us, and not to anybody as far as I know. That's just a fundamental shift in how Google works," Huffman said.

blocks.text: Reddit says demand for the platform hasn't changed, but Google simply stopped sending users there. In response, it's testing login walls outside the U.S. to curb scraping and reduce its dependence on the open web. Huffman sees it as a trade-off: less reach for deeper engagement. Data licensing talks with AI providers continue, though it's not certain that Reddit, which already had a deal with Google and massively profited from it, will close further ones.
